Hi Theo! Here are the notes from the design review for humanize_identifier: Foreign-key columns get a shorter label: when the identifier has more than one word and its last word is "id", that last word is dropped ("author_id" -> "Author", "parentPostId" -> "Parent post"). A lone "id" still becomes "ID", and "id" in any other position is kept ("id_card" -> "ID card").
